In
Egyptian mythology
,
Am-heh
was a minor god from the underworld, whose name means either "devourer of millions" or "eater of eternity".
[
1
]
He was depicted as a man with the head of a
hunting dog
who lived in a
lake of fire
.
[
2
]
He is sometimes seen as an aspect of
Ammit
, the personification of divine retribution. Am-heh could only be repelled by the god
Atum
.
